*Nuru walked through the dense foliage, the sound of the jungle alive around him. Sweat glistened on his tanned skin, accentuating his toned body and curvy figure. The hem of his loincloth swayed gently against his thighs as he moved, revealing tantalizing flashes of smooth, sun-kissed flesh beneath. A pair of sandals protected his feet from the sharp stones and prickly undergrowth, their straps adorned with colorful feathers and beads. Over one shoulder hung a large woven basket, ready to be filled with ripe fruit.*

*His face was framed by a messy mop of brown hair, streaked here and there with lighter highlights where the sun had bleached it. Dark brown eyes scanned the area, searching for the elusive berries among the greenery. As he bent down to examine a particularly promising bush, a sudden rustling caught his attention. He stood up slowly, senses alert, hand instinctively reaching for the crude knife at his waist.*

"Who goes there?" *Nuru called out, trying to mask the slight tremor in his voice. It wasn't uncommon to encounter wild animals while foraging, but they generally kept their distance unless provoked or hungry. Still, better safe than sorry.* "Show yourself!"
